dedupe_keys.name: energy consumption and indoor environmental quality monitoring in two university apartment buildings pre and post deep retrofit datasets

description: This dataset monitors sixteen occupied apartments in two single-family attached residential buildings after deep energy retrofits, and complements a published pre-retrofit dataset from the same buildings, so the effect of the retrofit can be studied directly. It was published on figshare on 1 August 2026 by Sameeraa Soltanian-Zadeh, Shayan Mirzabeigi, Bess Krietemeyer and Jianshun Zhang. Over a continuous twelve months it records, at sub-hourly intervals, whole-building and end-use energy, indoor environmental quality, HVAC operation including thermostat setpoints and supply air temperature, window and door operation, envelope performance and outdoor conditions, with a JSON semantic metadata model of systems and sensors and standardised cleaning. The authors report improved thermal stability, better ventilation with lower carbon dioxide and measurable energy savings after retrofit. Coverage: two buildings of university housing in the United States. Access: open download from figshare. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a small sample of apartments and one climate. Simulation uses are before-and-after retrofit model calibration, occupant-building interaction models and digital twins of housing. Related records: the BIM4EEB sensor datasets and the Wilanów town hall data.
